text: Color the fuchsia hexagons blue. Where can I go from the latest square?
Turn every star that is not red minuscule! That's the main flow. What is furthest to Villain? Send Intro to back.

Hmm, let me think. Tidy up, and then scale Check, Draft and Finish down. Okay, that's better. Rename the oldest black square Sage. I keep losing track of things. Park the yellow rhombus near Finish, and hook it to Begin!
Let me see. Link Seal to Fish. Also, write "end" on the oval, and drag the same one along the right edge.
Wire Dhcp to Rack3 with a dotted golden line. Swap the positions of Ap2 and Nas. Which cyan nodes are there? Sketch a big ball. Thanks!
Tie Card to Navbar and Navbar to Toolbar, then send Card to the back. After that, link it to Footer, and wire Search and Modal to Card!
Scale each ball down. Arrange them as a grid. Raise Dns.
We are planning the next sprint. Connect Kitchen to Hallway and Hallway to Office. What can I reach from Cellar? Undo twice.
Rename the black star Vortex. Almost done. Label the white oval payment.
Plonk a giant triangle labelled "start". We need it for the meeting. Bring that one to the front. Archive is a triangle. Make the triangles twice as large. Align them in a column!
Shove the triangles up by 75 pixels. Then arrange them in a grid! Is Banner joined to Footer? Insert a pair of rectangles in the upper-left corner, and remove each ellipse.
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Is Legal a dot? Rename this one to Jade.
Make every rose rhombus amber. Just tidying things up a bit. How large is Village? Make it a bit smaller. Nice.
My manager asked for this. Build an aqua hexagon to the right side of the navy ellipse. Striker is on top of Winger! Sketch 6 minuscule rose squares around Te. Nice.
Which shape is closest to Salt? Reposition the gold ellipse 25 points upwards, and dupe the oldest golden rectangle twice. Also, snip Salt from Whisk.
Organise in a row, and after that spread Todo, Doing and Sprint1 out in a row, and color rects violet. Turn the navy objects into an aqua rectangle. What text is on Doing?
Relocate Office and Closet right side of Bathroom, and then disregard the defaults. How many orange elements to the left of Studio?
Are there circles at the top-right? Send all of the diamonds backward. Is there an indigo rectangle between Bowl and Butter? What size is the grey square?
Rename the oval Zinnia. Draw a star reading "Pending", and after that join the star to Butter. Then hook Whisk to Milk, Flour and Salt.
What does the blue star say? Relocate the last rose dot on the right side, trash the rects. Then nudge the brown blocks along the left edge!

Create a two way line from Depot to Factory. After that, wire Depot, Truck, Supplier and Store one after the other with a line. Okay, that's better. List the triangles? Bring all of the black shapes in front, and draw a rect.
Change every box that is not gray to a large triangle. After that, swap Retailer and Dock.
Let me see. Plonk a green diamond. Ugh, messy. Color stars lime, then set all the squares to big!
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Slide all of the hexagons right. Next, arrange them in a row.
Write "payment" in Wr1! What shape is Tackle? How many pink nodes are there? Slide the triangles underneath Winger. Thanks!
Put Ready and Locked by Halted, swap Open2 with Running, and then make 3 violet hexagons.
Bucket in the upper right. Okay, that's better. Move Ingress, Cache and Pod2 down, and tidy up.
Send Carol to the back. Also, bring it to the front.
Replicate the Metrics 4 times. Is Team a star?
I'm explaining this to my team later. Forget all rules. What's connected to Grandma? Which one is biggest?
How many objects are not magenta? Always make boxes aqua.
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Build a small green rect with the name Onyx along the bottom. How small is the square? Is there a connection between Draft and Done?
Nudge Halted left 150px. List all orange diamonds? Describe the diagram?
Drag the triangle between Banner and Card. Are there any turquoise ovals that are not white?
Make an indigo circle below Clean. Change the orange items to a huge oval. Next, convert Train to a hexagon! What color is it?
Parse passes to Ingest. How many items are not orange? Add a star reading "Go".
Pop 9 giant pink diamonds in the top left, and then align them horizontal.
We are planning the next sprint. Is there a connection between Task7 and Blocked? Is Deployed on the top? Move that one on top of Doing.
Snip Mercury and Sun. We need it for the meeting. Describe the first red star? Slap a star named Onyx in the bottom left!
Show me the rules? List all arrows? Are there circles along the top?
We are planning the next sprint. Link Cellar to Studio. Going forward, diamonds are fuchsia. Thanks.
What color is Armed? Drag the same one underneath Error, and send this one to the back! What color is it? What color is it?
Make Chapter4 and Scene3 large! New triangles will be large. What's the location of the lime star? Connect Chapter4 and Ending with a green arrow. Also, place a small pink oval over Climax!
What is the color of the lime rect? Align Courier, Factory and Plant vertical, and then create a rhombus at the top edge. After that, bring the last one to the front.
Scoot Monitor underneath Deploy. Almost done. Stamp "Refund" on it. What rules are there? Does Source lead to Clean?
What's the furthest shape to the lime hexagon? Bring Grandpa to the front.
Timeline on the right of Users. Grow this one. Also, inscribe "Cancel" on the same one.
Add a caption "urgent" to Cache, and reset S3.
Raise the new hexagon, and then kill the link from Supplier to Plant. From now on, make triangles blue!
Reset the diagram. Okay, that's better. Call the newest rectangle Tango.
Hook Bathroom to Lounge, Porch and Garage. After that, drag Attic and Kitchen to the right, and after that Hallway and Attic trade places.
Is there a way to go from Marketing to Ceo? Change the lime rect to a minuscule triangle!
Hmm, let me think. Tie Aunt, Dad and Sophia all to each other. Which defaults are active? Bring all cyan boxes to the front.
Is there a cycle? Clear everything. Next, set the square to white.

My manager asked for this. Re-apply, then space Logo and Sidebar out in a row evenly. How big is the latest circle? Unhook Search from Header. Sorry, long day. Put Card, Search and Toolbar on the right of Logo.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Slap a golden square on the left of Router. What color is the newest one?
Throw a green square right of Emma. Reposition the stars upwards by 50 px. Because the old one was wrong. Align them vertical, then rename the latest diamond as Lark!
Reposition Banner and Modal left side of Menu. Pop a magenta triangle. Spread Search and Toolbar horizontally evenly.
Draw a white ellipse. Next, move the white ellipse along the top. Also, clone the same one 3 times. Which node is the rightmost?
Stick a red ball, and after that turn the scarlet ball violet!
Make Plankton three times larger. Pop a square. Also, inscribe "end" on the square!
Does Todo reach Story? Are there any green hexagons? Change the shape of all ellipses that are not orange to a hexagon!

Put a white rhombus. Raise the yellow star. After that, set the shape of the latest triangle to rhombus. Morph all the turquoise ones into an ellipse, and after that draw a big rectangle named Atlas between Whale and Squid.

We are planning the next sprint. Show me the connections? Undo that. I keep losing track of things. Fill the most recent lilac box with orange! That's the main flow. What does the earliest green triangle say?
Line up Porch, Office and Lounge in a column, and erase all the brown ones!
Which node has the most arrows? Create a connector from Validate to Monitor. Also, build a gold star named Wren between Validate and Source. Nice.
Turn all the shapes into a diamond. Is the graph circular? Turn the ovals into a square.
Ok, so I'm sketching our office network. Validate is above Loader. Send it to the back! Is Etl joined to the green dot?
Give every box a lime color. Also, push them 50 px down. We need it for the meeting. Align them horizontally.
New rectangles will be magenta. Send all the dots backward, and after that stick a hexagon titled "Back".
Unlink Footer from Sidebar. Is Menu connected to Search?
Park Finish and Review to the left. Space all shapes in a column, and then move them in the top right corner. Ugh, messy. Place Submit and Check at the top edge!
Label Climax with "checkout"! Is the silver diamond right side of the newest hexagon? Align Scene1 and Chapter4, and replicate Chapter4 two times.
Wipe out indigo diamonds. Also, stick a triangle along the left edge. Then duplicate the latest one 2 times. Attach Dungeon to Harbor and Harbor to Camp.
Delete all the gold ones. Next, change the color of every ellipse that is not lime to green.
Zap all the green ones, and drop the line between Cave and Camp. Thanks!
Is the black diamond smaller than Support? Erase the triangle, then swap Support with Hr!
Label the last ellipse Shipped, and color that one teal.
Make hexagons medium. Next, spawn an ellipse between Recruiting and Marketing, and copy the ellipse 2 times. Also, line up Ceo and Legal vertically. Also, clear everything!
Recolour all the gold ones brown. Build 5 big stars in the lower left. Is there a connection between Earth and the navy square? Show me the things?
Going forward, circles are red. Show me the stars? Turn blue hexagons into a brown star!
My manager asked for this. Make all the fuchsia ones a black hexagon, and spawn a brown ball!
Take that back! Can I get from Garage to Pantry? Rename the first diamond Prism. Drop every circle. Thanks.
Is the oldest block right of Navbar? Make all the shapes enormous. Next, trash the balls that are not lime.
Scoot Approve over the turquoise dot. Stamp "beta" on the same one.

We are planning the next sprint. Park the newest triangle near Flour, and rename this one to Opal. Put Eggs and Bowl along the left edge, and throw a green oval. Attach Flour to Batter and Batter to Mix.
From now on, squares are minuscule and golden. Rename the newest square into Pebble.
Park the white block between Mars and Venus. I keep losing track of things. Color it blue. What color is the same one?
Turn every dot that is not orange into a little orange star. Okay, that's better. Tie Check to Submit. Almost done. Label the latest blue ball as urgent, and make a copy of the oldest triangle.
Is the last green square larger than Deployed? Shove the star upwards, and put a rose block by Epic. Then make the last one bigger.
Make Pantry a black triangle. What is farthest to Bathroom?
Attach Alice and Carol to Olivia, and dupe Mom twice. What can I reach from Alice?
Let me see. Sketch an average circle titled "payment" around Locked. Copy the dot 2 times. Then change all the magenta squares to a regular star.
What is the rightmost shape? Forget the rules. We need it for the meeting. Delete all navy stars.
Cut Battery and Relay. Almost done. New triangles should be magenta! Is there a loop? Is Vcc larger than Ground?
Build a green triangle beneath the rectangle. Then draw an orange star called Ivy. Then slide the blue diamond up, and make this one turquoise!
Scoot Cto, Lead and Coo right. In future, dots are little and teal. Nice.
Triangles should be indigo from now on. What is attached to Castle? Is the Cave between Forest and Tower? Move it in the lower left!
Join Mercury to Neptune and Neptune to Sun! Diamonds should be lime from now on.
Let me see. Which shape is the leftmost? Align Metrics, Users and Goals vertical!
